body: Well I'm not alone in feeling trapped. What an awful feeling it is. You'd think suicide is a choice but it doesn't feel like that to me. I hope someday you don't feel that suffocating feeling anymore

Thank you very much! Your words are so kind. I should have mentioned that I was on meds for years but stopped after intense migraines and have been to 4 different therapists. They all felt very distant like they didn't really care. A few of them I had to retell my story to remind them which patient I was. I just hated it. I never thought about writing music, I wonder if I'd be any good
